text.p: Prudential Securities said on Thursday it initiated coverage of JetFax Inc with a buy rating and a 12- to 18-month price target of $14 per share.
-- Analyst Alex Henderson said he estimated the company, which supplies multifunction technology, would earn $0.10 per share in 1997 and $0.50 per share in 1998.

-- JetFax produces branded multifunction machines which can print, copy, scan and fax, and also supplies OEMs with the enabling technology to allow them to develop their own multifuntion products, he said in a research note.
-- Henderson said JetFax has licensing agreements with a number of companies, including Hewlett-Packard, which should drive results.
-- "The potential from HP alone could thus be about $3-$4 million in near 100 percent profitable revenues, which translates into an additional $0.15-$0.20 per share in 1998 earnings," he wrote.
